verdict.rationale: The evidence covers the npm CLI and the raw registry HTTP API (search qualifiers, packument endpoint), but nothing documents an official SDK or client library for building against npm programmatically. A documented HTTP API is a building block, not an official SDK, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404. An official SDK is a fair question for a registry service, so this axis applies and the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
